terms.comment: The late-antique name, stem quantities left unmarked; Serdicae — in Sofia; Serdicēnsis — of Sofia.
evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Sophia oder Triaditza: Ulpia Sardica, Sardica

phrases.latin: Lisbōnā Bergomum, Bergomō Serdicam, Serdicā domum.
phrases.english: From Lisbon to Bergamo, from Bergamo to Sofia, from Sofia home.
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).

J. G. Th. Graesse, Orbis Latinus (Dresden, 1861), German–Latin index, read in the scan at archive.org (the 1909 edition at columbia.edu could not be reached page by page); its forms are post-classical unless Lewis & Short has them.
